meta_reflection.observation: Filings-first order is adequate only if period tags and intra-year coverage are true. For BT-A.L they are not: period_coverage annual=8/interim=0/trading_update=1 is eight Companies House group accounts (2019–2026) plus one mis-tagged ‘Across The Markets’ wrap, while the live 22 Jul 2026 REG Trading Statement and 29 Jun Verizon JV exist only as news headlines. yahoo_quarterly_cashflow is on the ladder but empty (TTM suppressed); alternate_news and ir_presentation_metrics are dead steps. Headline-only news therefore carries the only post-FY26 operating prints, ranked below empty quarterlies.

Four worker types plus a five-task cap force one (or two) CH annual bodies + news + screen + gap and leave no slot for a later-ingested Q1 TU, the Verizon JV RNS, or FY26 prelim slides. There is no tagged interim, so a second summarize_filing_body cannot be an H1 without inventing a source; assigning the catalogued trading_update would make a worker summarise a Hollywood Bowl/Castings aggregator. No task type exists to reconcile filing/Yahoo 1,861m versus screen TTM 1,200.4m FCF, Openreach versus EE/Consumer versus Global/JV perimeter, or lease-plus-pension economic leverage.

The screen still emits buy (6/22, 5/5 families including FCF Yield at 9.3% and Neff PEGY at 0.05 despite growth −9.0%) while failed_models is [] despite 16/22 non-passes, TTM cashflow is suppressed, and fcf_definition_divergence / leverage_override / interim_quality_overlay stay false on a two-way FCF split, £18.3bn net debt and a £4.4bn pension deficit. A 5-week persistent buy since 2026-08-16 with a news-only July trading statement, a live Verizon JV, Bharti/NSI ownership headlines, gilt-refinancing risk, and no H1 FY27 statutory as of 4 Sep (typical BT November window) has no watch schema (ingest of the 22 Jul TU / next H1, JV close and remaining international earnings, Openreach build vs harvest / Ofcom charge-control, pension/gilt refinancing, remaining buyback vs TVR). conviction_score 1.0 versus summary ‘Conviction 67%’ and stability_label=persistent are not substitutes for those monitors.

A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend Openreach wholesale, EE/Consumer, Global/JV and BTPS and will not force SEGMENT / PERIMETER (Openreach vs EE vs Global vs Verizon JV), FCF-DEFINITION (Yahoo/filing 1,861m vs screen TTM 1,200.4m), LEASE-PLUS-PENSION vs EX-LEASE NET DEBT, FIBRE-CYCLE (peak build vs harvest), CAPITAL RETURNS (4.0% dividend vs cash buybacks), OWNERSHIP/NSI, or an explicit PRIMARY-FILING GAP box for the missing July TU and JV RNS.
